scope: Native browser text observations, truthful browser capabilities, text-evidence freshness and bounded document readiness

status.tested: 21 final regression methods and the unchanged real GitHub HostSession task pass, no skips
status.accepted: These component scopes and one real GitHub release task; broader task generalization and production remain open

changes: Replace only the browser tool schema within the pinned Fara prompt. Preserve the trained identity, critical-point rules and XML response protocol. Advertise implemented browser actions, normalized scroll distance, key limits, HTTP(S) navigation and bounded reading.

Project at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes of admitted rendered text and associated title tooltips into the current actor observation, alongside its current source URL and truncation/embedded-content flags. This reuses the host observation already gathered before inference and adds no extraction call.

Bind this explicit observation to the current browser URL, reject it on desktop inputs, include its serialized bytes in the aggregate conversation bound and omit it from old observations. The existing read-page tool uses the same projection; its extracted-answer protocol remains distinct.
Require native text evidence to remain current before accepting a model completion. The identical-screenshot exception applies only when no native text or page-reading data informed the answer.

Identify document-loading replies separately for read-only page snapshots and wait up to three seconds for that state. Each poll retains the original document, owner and source checks and repeats login admission. Existing action validation still rejects stale state; no input is retried.
Record the existing native capture stage in the explicit public diagnostic report.
findings: A real public-page probe using the original tool schema chose Find in ordinary planning and scrolling after unsupported-URL feedback. A truthful tool schema alone still chose scrolling. Both bounded probes failed their reader-selection criterion; no generated input was sent.

Adding native page text made the ordinary proposal retain the exact version, date and official URL in a memorization step. The one-proposal recovery variant still chose a click and remains unaccepted; no generated click was dispatched.

All three probes use the exact same saved current screenshot and semantically identical saved page reading. Recovery replay reconstructed its earlier history image from the saved current image because the original history image was not retained; no exact full-history equivalence is claimed.

The first automatic-text red test and its first green batch were invalid for the intended integration check because the fixture had not claimed its browser session. The corrected controlled red run removed only the new executor-to-actor text attachment; it demonstrated both absent native text and acceptance of an obsolete tooltip fact despite identical pixels. Both pass after wiring text and requiring current text evidence.

The capability red test detected unsupported advertised actions and missing bounds. One compiler failure from a shared GUI-Owl helper rename and one from a text attachment placed in history were corrected; both failed build records are retained.

The native readiness test first failed immediately with pageEvidenceUnavailable. Its five modes now pass: delayed readiness, cancellation, changed owner, login appearing during loading, and a bounded never-ready failure. The same native window is retained across those modes; rejected modes stop before screenshot capture.

An initial full task with native text failed after navigation in 22.13 seconds before a second model proposal. Its generic page-reading failure was not stage-traced, so it does not prove the exact rejection condition. The independently reproduced loading-state defect was then repaired.

The unchanged full task now passes in 56.49 seconds: four model replies, two verified native dispatch journals, the actual official release page visited and the original independent version/date/link oracle satisfied. One intermediate proposed click was not dispatched. At most one worker is observed across 464 samples and zero remain after shutdown.
The final 21-method regression batch and full task both pass by exact identifiers, zero skips. The public run retains the existing main-thread UI-unresponsiveness warning.
remainingWork: Qualify this general observation path on the requested travel/concert/movie and other public tasks, including missing or truncated data, rather than treating one release task as general acceptance.
Continue real provider login, physical-phone/installed-host control and transport qualification, native/cross-app coverage and exact-result/no-replay requirements in TODO.md.
Measure whole-Mac 12 GB memory, swap/heat/idle and resolve the UI warning before production acceptance. Individual worker samples are not whole-app qualification.
The bounded model rejection-history probe remains unaccepted. Preserve that counterexample when qualifying recovery; the successful normal full task did not encounter an unsupported URL.
limitations: MCP remains first. No model selection, managed installation, 4 GiB worker cap or installed-app behavior was intentionally changed outside these browser paths.

The final public task uses the existing diagnostic HostSession composition with the normal runtime/loader, an explicit exchange observer and isolated journals. It is not physical-phone or installed status-item acceptance.

The native readiness test controls document.readyState in the isolated test world. The actual public run separately verifies the full workflow; the prior generic page-read failure is not retrospectively assigned a proven cause.

Frozen selection tests are bounded diagnostics, not autonomous completion tests. Earlier candidate sources changed during the turn; final source hashes below bind the last regression/full task, not every earlier candidate.
The new observation is website data, not an extracted or independently verified answer. It excludes text omitted by the existing native collector and explicitly reports coverage limits.

independentOracle.scope: Independent oracle, not provided to the app

oracleRecheck: Read-only official GitHub API check before the current real task sequence returned the same tag 2.102.0, published_at 2026-09-01T09:35:32Z, draft=false, prerelease=false and official release URL. Those expected values are not supplied to the full task planner.
